entries.01d640b8ff3b5c86: A business that sells industrial machinery and welding materials in Japan and overseas, consisting of 2 units, machinery and welding. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥92,250 million.
entries.2a743fb05a334376: A unit that procures coal, ferroalloys and iron ore from Japan and overseas and sells them, mainly to Kobe Steel. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥77,652 million (down 3.7% year on year). The company explains that lower steel demand weakened crude steel production and lowered the prices of its main raw materials. It also cites resource recycling business and biomass fuel handling as priority areas. In Australia, Kobelco Trading Australia Pty. Ltd. holds a coal interest (equity stake of 0.5%) in a coal mine development in Queensland.
entries.74f66844512b9025: A unit that sells mainly industrial machinery, chemical machinery and electronics-related equipment in Japan and overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥63,726 million (up 4.2% year on year). The company explains that in Japan, deliveries increased of non-general-purpose compressors, decarbonization-related equipment such as refrigeration and heat pump equipment, PVD equipment and equipment for Kobe Steel's steelworks; overseas, exports of construction machinery parts in China and deliveries of LNG-related equipment in the US increased.
entries.9c006c47bc8fb9dc: A specialized trading company closely tied to Kobe Steel that buys and sells steel, aluminum, copper, machinery, welding materials, and more in Japan and overseas.
entries.a39b4555de8c5449: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments.
entries.a6d1872b3102def6: A unit that sells, mainly specialty steel and steel plates, as well as steel bars, cast and forged steel, titanium, stainless steel products and iron powder, in Japan and overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥250,092 million (down 3.0% year on year), the largest of the 5 units. The company explains that although automobile production remained at the previous year's level, revenue fell due to lower demand from construction and lower steel prices. Grand Blanc Processing,L.L.C. in Michigan, USA holds steel wire drawing, pickling and heat treatment equipment for this unit (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.a8f0763ceaa70a33: The company's core business, purchasing steel, aluminum, copper and raw materials in Japan and overseas and selling them. It consists of 3 units, steel, aluminum and copper, and raw materials; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥515,691 million, accounting for the bulk of consolidated revenue of ¥608,142 million.
entries.aed70e22b0743329: A business segment not included in the reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥199 million, small, and the business details are not described in detail in this report.
entries.af895fabd2bd789b: A unit that sells mainly welding materials, production materials and welding-related equipment in Japan and overseas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥28,524 million (down 2.3% year on year). The company explains that handling volume of welding materials rose in Japan and overseas but overseas selling prices fell, and that among production materials, stainless materials increased while solvent raw materials decreased slightly.
entries.cd089b4c0011ea39: A unit that sells mainly aluminum and copper products for automobiles and air conditioning in Japan and overseas, and also procures and sells non-ferrous raw materials such as recycled aluminum ingots and copper scrap. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥187,946 million (down 0.1% year on year), second only to steel in size. The company explains that while handling of copper strip for terminal connectors and copper tubes for air conditioners increased, handling volume of aluminum products for automobiles decreased. Suzhou Shenshang Metal Co., Ltd. in Jiangsu Province, China holds a non-ferrous processing factory (as of March 31, 2026).
